note: City of Jacksonville campground on 500-acre Lake Jacksonville, south of town. A small overnight area of gravel and concrete pads with electric sits by the boat ramp and concession; most of the lakeshore is leased seasonal camping lots, which overnight guests cannot use. Fill the fresh-water tank on arrival. --Claude
summary: City lake page, overnight regulations + fee sheet (2022) and lease-lot rules read; Google 4.5/11; imagery. Overnight rates $25-$30 city / $30-$35 others (no rate stored before). Water hookup false (no direct hook-up). Max 40 ft. Season Apr 1-Oct 14 (2026). Phone reservations within 30 days, 14-night max. Real transient area (~14 pads) beside a large lease-lot program. Not waterfront kept.
flags: LONG-STAY / PUBLIC (local, reviewer): the lakeshore is mostly leased seasonal lots ('permanent camper lottery', waiting list, decks and roof-overs regulated), but the city runs a separate overnight campground with posted daily rates, 30-day phone reservations and a 14-night limit. Imagery shows ~14 back-in pads in that area (39.6785,-90.1928). Real public campground; no gate (local).
